findings.text: follow-on: the new test file ends without a trailing newline, so `ruff format --check tests/test_warm_pick_rescans_no_plan.py` reports "File would be reformatted"; the repository requires a commit's staged paths add no lint or format findings.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base; the diff splits routing._docs_scan_directories into _docs_scan_inputs (returning the directory-and-file pair the estimate stamps) and _docs_scan_directories (returning the directory list the picker's stamp reads), adds tests/test_warm_pick_rescans_no_plan.py with a shape test and a warm-resolve test, and adds the empty evidence-fragment anchor section.
item_verdicts.done_when: the section required reproducing tests/test_pick_stages_fit_the_bound.py::test_the_cut_stops_the_repeated_docs_scan failing at base 223187b5c with 2 warm-pick rescans; defect-base.log records FAILED at 223187b5c, defect-head.log records the same test passed at ba4ca787d, and I independently reproduced both in a scratch copy (reviewer-head-newtests.log 2 passed EXIT=0, reviewer-mutation.log 3 failed EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to make a warm pick resolve the plan path without re-walking the docs tree while keeping the estimated-hours stamp's sibling-file shape; reckon/crew/routing.py:3684 _docs_scan_directories now returns the docs-relative directory list the picker's stamp iterates and routing.py:3732 _estimated_hours reads the new _docs_scan_inputs pair, so a warm pick resolves 0 plans through a scan where it resolved 2.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names the cause (commit ab5883931 changed routing._docs_scan_directories to return a tuple) with the call path pick()->_declared_difficulty()->picker._resolved_plan_path()->build()/stamp_of, carries baseline_suite (223187b5c, exit 0, completed true) and after_suite (ba4ca787d, exit 0, completed true) with literal commands, a negative_control_log naming the mutation, and changed_paths listing the three files.
item_verdicts.write_paths: git diff 223187b5c..ba4ca787d touches exactly reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_warm_pick_rescans_no_plan.py and docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/pick-cache-survives-the-sibling-stamp.html, all inside the node's declared write paths; no figure was created, which the small-node rule permits.

justifications.durability: in a scratch copy I reverted _docs_scan_directories to return the tuple and reviewer-mutation.log shows tests/test_warm_pick_rescans_no_plan.py:55, :71 and the sibling cut test all fail (3 failed EXIT=1), so the added assertions genuinely fire on the regression.
justifications.evidence: gate-head.log line 1 names revision ba4ca787d and the tree and ends 207 passed EXIT=0 while gate-base.log ends 205 passed EXIT=0, a 0-added delta, and reviewer-mutation.log independently reddens the guard at 3 failed EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/routing.py:3684 carries a stray blank line between its docstring and return, and tests/test_warm_pick_rescans_no_plan.py:96 is not ruff-format clean (FINDING below).
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/routing.py:3692 makes _docs_scan_directories return _docs_scan_inputs(docs)[0], the list[str] reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:111 stores as "directories", so stamp_of no longer raises and the fallback rescan is not taken.
justifications.reuse: the change makes _docs_scan_directories a one-line delegate over the single walk in routing._docs_scan_inputs rather than forking the scan, and a grep for both helpers finds only the picker stamp and _estimated_hours as consumers.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 223187b5c..ba4ca787d lists exactly reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_warm_pick_rescans_no_plan.py and the evidence fragment, the node's declared write paths, and nothing else.
